scope: platform-api/app production Python outside repository-named modules
policy: Direct SQL outside repository-named modules requires a bounded owner and persistence reason. This registry records existing colocated transactions and read models; it does not exempt modules from stricter domain boundaries or authorize new SQL surfaces.

platform-api/app/auth.py.reason: Legacy authentication state queries remain colocated with the bounded auth policy.

platform-api/app/catalog.py.reason: Legacy catalog read and bootstrap queries are not migrated in Phase 4-R1.

platform-api/app/credential_security.py.reason: Bounded credential rotation and revocation state owner.

platform-api/app/database_bootstrap.py.reason: Canonical schema bootstrap owner; repository migration is outside R1.

platform-api/app/database_seeds.py.reason: Deterministic seed owner used only for maintained bootstrap flows.

platform-api/app/disaster_recovery.py.reason: Operational recovery evidence and restore coordination owner.

platform-api/app/eod_policy.py.reason: Small legacy policy lookup retained without expanding its SQL surface.

platform-api/app/execution_risk.py.reason: Auditable risk state machine retained as an explicit legacy transactional owner.

platform-api/app/live_trading_sessions.p.reason: Live-session lifecycle and fail-closed authorization owner.

platform-api/app/market_data.py.reason: Small maintained market snapshot persistence owner.

platform-api/app/ops.py.reason: Operational state queries retained within the bounded ops surface.

platform-api/app/production_monitoring.p.reason: Read-only production monitoring and evidence aggregation owner.

platform-api/app/production_operations_p.reason: Small legacy production-operation policy lookup owner.

platform-api/app/schema_migrations.py.reason: Canonical migration owner; direct DDL is intentional.

platform-api/app/security.py.reason: Bounded security event and lockout persistence owner.

platform-api/app/trade_command_execution.reason: Existing command execution state transition owner.

platform-api/app/trade_commands.py.reason: Trade command journal and idempotency owner.

platform-api/app/trading.py.reason: Existing order, fill, position and PnL projection owner; R1 adds recovery calls but no new SQL owner.

platform-api/app/v1_readiness.py.reason: Readiness evidence queries retained without expanding the production interface.

platform-api/app/account_history_sync.py.reason: Reads native history, missing-fill evidence and history job status; writes remain through snapshot and read-job owners.

platform-api/app/account_performance.py.reason: Owns capital movements, coverage and capital sync state used by account returns; does not allocate account returns to strategies.

platform-api/app/account_read_jobs.py.reason: Persists per-account read-job status and combines it with capital synchronization status.

platform-api/app/controlled_strategy_wri.reason: Reads strategy definitions and active bindings to reject legacy execution bypasses; no persistence writes.

platform-api/app/cross_session_valuation.reason: Reads historical spread, account-risk and session evidence for market-closure-aware valuation; no financial fact writes.

platform-api/app/cross_spread.py.reason: Reads the active bound venue account identity; lifecycle writes remain in the exit-plan repository.

platform-api/app/cross_spread_close_reco.reason: Existing bounded transaction rechecks original close leg, risk disposition and plan before moving their recovery states together.

platform-api/app/cross_spread_position_r.reason: Reads proven native closes, pending intents and account sync; atomically closes only the matching exit plan and appends its audit.

platform-api/app/cross_spread_synthetic_.reason: Reads original batch-leg and command identity before reusing an existing close intent; no direct SQL writes.

platform-api/app/data_audit.py.reason: Reads persisted producer and projection evidence and owns retained data_audit_runs reports; never alters source financial facts.

platform-api/app/data_audit_calendar.py.reason: Owns the persisted CN exchange-calendar cache and freshness metadata.

platform-api/app/funding.py.reason: Reads bound account environment and native instrument mappings; execution remains through instruction and command owners.

platform-api/app/funding_settlement_acco.reason: Reads original strategy runs, native settlement events and fills for evidence-based attribution; no fact mutation.

platform-api/app/live_venue_snapshot_syn.reason: Owns atomic current account frames, synchronization status and append-only native venue events; preserves source identities.

platform-api/app/order_record_readmodel..reason: Reads batch direction, risk-generated order membership and native MT5 fill metadata; no direct writes.

platform-api/app/research_cumulative_vol.reason: Existing producer replaces only derived cumulative-volatility sampling rows in research_a_share_history; reads its serving coverage and series.

platform-api/app/strategy_daily_valuatio.reason: Reads historical spread, FX and account-risk observations for Beijing-day valuation; missing evidence stays unavailable.

platform-api/app/strategy_financial_read.reason: Read-only aggregation of canonical fills, native events and strategy ownership; no formal accounting writes.

platform-api/app/strategy_management_pro.reason: Owns strategy_management_projection demand, attempts, published payload and error state; canonical inputs remain unchanged.

platform-api/app/strategy_research_proje.reason: Owns derived research_strategy_projection rows and their incremental/backfill cursors; original archives remain authoritative.

platform-api/app/strategies/capital_tran.reason: Existing transaction claims transfer resources and reserves balance together with internal_capital_transfers; no new venue capability is granted.

platform-api/app/strategies/funding_clos.reason: Rechecks original close identity, native fills and remaining capacity before claiming one recovery release and audit in a bounded transaction.

platform-api/app/strategies/funding_orch.reason: Owns persisted perpetual attempts and spot releases and coordinates existing batch/leg/run states under original frozen intent.

platform-api/app/strategies/funding_runn.reason: Reads only the existing persisted runnable instruction queue; execution is delegated to instruction_service.

platform-api/app/strategies/funding_work.reason: Reads symbol mappings, original instruction/attempt/release facts, balance and reservations for the workspace; no direct writes.

platform-api/app/strategies/instruction_.reason: Owns atomic frozen instruction, batch and leg publication and state transitions; rechecks idempotency and close capacity in the same transaction.

platform-api/app/strategies/plan_service.reason: Reads bindings, specifications, native fill evidence and reserved close capacity to build frozen plans; no direct writes.
